record.question:
What are the financial powers delegated to MPWD Officers in the following circumstances?
(a) Award of Original Urgent works through call of quotations by EE/DDH.
(b) To accord Administrative Approval and expenditure sanction to minor works (as defined in para 1.3.3 vide OM DG/MAN/247 dated 07.06.2012) for residential and non-residential buildings by SE.
(c) Grant of extension of time and rescheduling of milestones without levy of compensation by AE/AEE.
(d) Accord of technical sanction to detailed estimates and issue of NIT/Composite NIT in Maintenance works by EE/DDH.
(e) Award of work order (Annual limit) Normal works through publicity on NIT/Notice board in original works by AE/AEE/ADH.
